purpose: Acceptance contract for the GPG-001 broker bootstrap and local/global gate-control release candidate.
sourceRequest: Implement the approved central GitHub App/broker algorithm, enforceable machine/App checks, Windows/WSL preflight, adoption, doctor, and deployable bootstrap while preserving exact-candidate, independent-review, fail-closed, and secret-isolation guarantees.

criteria.criterion: Candidate acquisition uses complete GitHub compare pagination plus bounded full base/head blobs, treats merge_base_commit as an independently validated ancestor rather than the current base, verifies decoded size and Git blob SHA, and emits one deterministic canonical diff without trusting patch fields or truncating; merge-group PR composition is explicitly paginated to a hard bound.
criteria.evidence: Orchestration mutations accept a valid behind-base PR, reject incomplete commit/component pagination, missing/mismatched/oversized blobs, unsafe paths, binary content, stale coordinates, and over-limit candidates before provider dispatch.

criteria.criterion: The selected Responses API reviewer is derived from verified maker provenance, receives only the clean bounded final diff, uses a strict structured verdict, and settles only primary token usage against the frozen integer-microusd budget. Diffs above the direct-call bound are scrubbed in full, partitioned without truncation into a bounded deterministic review plan, and can pass only after every unit plus an integration verdict agree.
criteria.evidence: Route, request-bound, invalid-output, missing-usage, outage, overspend, exhaustion, same-identity, missing-unit, forged-plan, over-limit-line, and partial-integration mutations fail closed without CLI/OAuth substitution; ambiguous hierarchical calls charge observed usage plus one call cap.

criteria.criterion: The broker creates the App-owned Check Run on the policy-selected SHA and external ID and requires an exact durable preparation before every terminal PATCH: full cross-bound review evidence for reviewed outcomes or closed typed failure evidence for early fail-closed outcomes. It observes and atomically finalizes each publication; interrupted publications are recoverable without another model call.
criteria.evidence: Mutations reject stale head/base/check SHA, forged App identity, wrong external ID, missing preparation/observation, non-clean verdict, and unavailable reviewer; every success/action_required/failure PATCH proves matching prior evidence, and lost GitHub responses for success and failure are recovered without repeating provider review.

criteria.criterion: The HTTP service reads a bounded body, verifies the exact-byte webhook HMAC and signed event/action shape before state change, uses the broker-owned public provenance keyring, and returns explicit fail-closed HTTP outcomes.
criteria.source: Approved central GitHub App/broker security boundary.
criteria.evidence: Server tests cover health/readiness, overload, malformed/oversized/signature-mismatched events, replay, clean enqueue, worker failure, and graceful shutdown.

criteria.criterion: Runtime configuration loads reviewer/App/webhook secrets only from bounded permission-checked files, never from repository content or OPENAI_API_KEY, and never exposes credentials to candidate execution.
criteria.evidence: Environment/bootstrap mutations reject missing, relative, permissive, malformed, oversized, and user-environment secret sources; the broker never checks out or executes candidate code.

criteria.criterion: Accepted trust primitives remain green while the executable layer uses their closed schemas, strict JCS/I-JSON, enrollment, provenance, budget, App authentication, and immutable review APIs without compatibility bypasses.
criteria.evidence: Policy and primitive regression suites pass unchanged together with orchestration/server suites.

criteria.criterion: This bootstrap slice stages (but does not activate) the machine-oracle workflow template and server-side ruleset machinery while the legacy gate remains active. After a separate protected-anchor merge, the template is installed and pinned by repository ID, path, and release SHA; it loads the protected runner/v2 contract, binds verifier dependencies, isolates Python, executes shell-free argv over the exact candidate, and emits a bound receipt without reviewer secrets.
criteria.evidence: Oracle/workflow/ruleset mutations cover bootstrap order, pinned source and drift, same-name status rejection, protected contract/verifiers, exact-tree isolation, Python -I, schema/artifact/output/receipt binding, and pull_request plus merge_group.

criteria.criterion: Windows and WSL global pre-push hooks block protected-branch pushes, unregistered GitHub checkouts, missing maker provenance, and stale or foreign machine receipts while allowing only an explicitly guarded exact-HEAD PR push.
criteria.evidence: Cross-platform hook and installer mutations prove fail-closed behavior, explicit repository binding, no plugin-cache edits, and separate native host installation targets.

criteria.criterion: The global itd CLI creates Draft PRs only through the guarded exact-candidate path, signs maker provenance, waits for current App-owned and machine checks, manages the canonical no-bypass ruleset, registers adoption only after live validation, observes closed enrollment metadata, and inventories controlled repositories in doctor --all.
criteria.evidence: CLI mutations cover transient check availability, forged integration identity, live ruleset/workflow drift, invalid App permissions/events, registry write ordering, organization inventory, rejection of local-only bootstrap contracts, and protected status.

criteria.criterion: The broker has a reproducible least-privilege deployment package with pinned dependencies, unprivileged read-only execution, bounded loopback exposure, explicit health/readiness, and credential-file isolation.
criteria.evidence: Deployment tests validate image/runtime boundaries, Compose/systemd/Caddy configuration, private file modes, readiness, and secret-source rejection.

criteria.criterion: The dedicated private GitHub App can be created through the official manifest flow with the exact HTTPS broker webhook, least-privilege permissions, only pull_request and merge_group events, CSRF-bound loopback conversion, atomic private credential persistence outside the repository, and no retained OAuth client secret.
criteria.evidence: Manifest tests reject invalid origins, callbacks, organizations, codes, conversion fields, and overwrite attempts while checking the documented GitHub API version and 0600/0700 persistence.

criteria.criterion: Adoption and operator documentation name the central App/broker as the required authority, retain Codex/Gemini CLI only as advisory transports, require live enforceability before protected status, and never direct operators to edit an installed plugin cache or persist or expose a runtime reviewer API key.
criteria.evidence: Release, host-adapter, methodology meta-review, and deployment documentation checks pass with the legacy repository gate retained through trust-anchor bootstrap; removal is a separate post-deployment cutover only after protected doctor and negative canaries pass.

criteria.criterion: The broker operator adds public provenance keys and exact live enrollment receipts through schema-validated preview/apply commands, uses private atomic files, rejects overwrite or mutation of active enrollment, and never prints credential material.
criteria.evidence: Operator mutations cover preview, apply, private modes, invalid records, duplicate key IDs, exact App client IDs, immutable enrollment, and status lookup.

criteria.criterion: Codex and Claude host adapters remain transport-only and expose the same vendor-neutral methodology, contracts, hooks, and review authority after the new global gate artifacts are added.
criteria.source: Approved plan item 4 and the host-adapter contract.
criteria.evidence: Host-adapter verification passes against the staged methodology source without editing either installed plugin cache.

doneRule: A criterion status of passed means its verification command passed, not that the candidate is accepted. This slice remains in_progress until a current high-risk exact-candidate Verification Loop receipt revalidates. It does not claim live broker/App/ruleset deployment, private-org protection, credential rotation, or final release/install.
